theorem nsmulPt_eq_pow (L : RelativeGroupLaw S f) {T : Scheme.{0}} (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of S)) (k : ℕ) (X : SchemeHomOver t f) :
    nsmulPt L t k X = @HPow.hPow _ ℕ _ (@instHPow _ ℕ (@Monoid.Pow _ (L.pointGroup t).toMonoid)) X k
-- Proof: induction on k. Zero case: `(pow_zero X).symm`, via the `Monoid` structure of `pointGroup`. Successor case: unfold `nsmulPt` by `rfl` to `L.mul t (nsmulPt L t k X) X`, rewrite with the induction hypothesis and `pow_succ`, then close by `rfl`.
